explanation:
This account is produced without the reasoning agent: it lists the observed facts without cross-examining or interpreting them.

Launch: Launched on Virtuals. At launch, 50% of the supply went to Virtuals’ launch curve: 35.1% bought there, then at graduation on Sep 23, 2026 10.5% to its Uniswap v2 pair and 4.5% to Virtuals’ graduation-excess wallet, and 50% to Virtuals’ reserve wallet, which passed it all on within 2 minutes: 25% to Virtuals’ capital-formation wallet (ACF), which still holds 18%, and 25% to Virtuals’ team lock (TokenTable), where 28.6% is locked for the creator (3.6% of it added after the launch), unlocking from Nov 29, 2026 to Jan 25, 2028. Nobody bought in the first minutes: the supply was only handed out.

Creator: this token was launched through Virtuals, whose launch record names 0xc47ff45c87ee89a999b95ed6d4f408674d9bed9f. The wallet has sent 11 transactions. Through the same launch contract, this address launched 1 token. Of 1 launch checked, the creator sold into the market on 0 within the first 11 days after each launch. Of 1 with a market that could be read, liquidity was removed on 0 in the first 11 days after each launch. It graduated from its launch curve to an open market.

Holders: the largest, Virtuals’ capital-formation wallet (ACF), holds 33.7 % of the supply held outside pools, locks and burn addresses; the top 10 hold 70.0 % combined. 28.6 % of the supply sits in Virtuals’ team lock (TokenTable): locked, it is left out of these shares.

Market: price 0.0001747 USD, liquidity 45746.01 USD.

Over 24 hours: 2808.12 USD in volume across 10 trades, averaging 280.81 USD per trade.
